# The Leander Local Guide
> A guide to Leander, Texas and its local food scene. Honest, first-person reviews by Anthony Martinez ("The Leander Local") of every restaurant, bar, cafe, brewery, bakery and food truck in Leander, TX.

## Key pages
- [The guide](https://leanderlocalguide.com/): Every food and drink spot in Leander, TX, with Anthony's verdict, hours, and what to order.
- [Best of Leander](https://leanderlocalguide.com/best): Power rankings — best tacos, BBQ, pizza, Indian (desi), burgers, coffee, bars, bakeries, food trucks, and patios in Leander.
- [Hidden Gems](https://leanderlocalguide.com/hidden-gems): Under-the-radar local spots in Leander.
- [About Anthony](https://leanderlocalguide.com/about): The local behind the guide.

## About
Covers Leander, Texas (ZIPs 78641 and 78645) only — not Austin or Cedar Park. Reviews are first-person editorial opinion by Anthony Martinez, grounded in real local visits and aggregated public reviews. ~180 spots. Categories: restaurants, bars, breweries, cafes, bakeries, dessert, food trucks. Cuisines include Tex-Mex, Indian, BBQ, pizza, burgers, Vietnamese, Mediterranean, and more. Anti-chain, pro-local.
